answer: Each epoch, a randomness beacon publishes a challenge word (imagine it lands on wharf, forge, or ripple) and every agent must produce a fresh reply tied to that word plus its own unforgeable signing key. Precomputed template answers are useless because the word is unknown until the beacon fires, so attackers cannot mass-produce responses in advance. To pass, a sybil must run a real reasoning process per fake identity per epoch, paying compute and fees each time, which makes bulk fake identities unprofitable.
